mapper.select: select openai_order.order_id, openai_order.product_name, openai_order.pay_url, openai_order.pay_status, openai_order.total_amount from openai_order where openid = #{openid} and product_id = #{productId} and order_status = 0 order by id desc limit 1

mapper.select: select openid, product_id, product_name, product_quota, order_id, order_time, order_status, total_amount, pay_type, pay_status, pay_time from openai_order where order_id = #{orderId}
